steps.en: Officer opens the notice search page
Officer picks Apply Revival for the selected notices
steps.id: Officer memilih Apply Revival untuk notice terpilih

steps.en: Revival type is detected from the notice, not picked by the officer
steps.id: Jenis revival dideteksi dari notice, tidak dipilih officer
steps.why_en: No type picker exists; one Apply Revival option and the system decides TS or PS.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pemilih jenis; hanya satu opsi Apply Revival dan sistem yang menentukan TS atau PS.

steps.en: Temporary suspension on the notice can be revived
steps.id: Temporary suspension pada notice bisa direvive

steps.en: Permanent suspension on the notice can be revived
steps.id: Permanent suspension pada notice bisa direvive

steps.en: Reducing the fine can be undone and the amount goes back
steps.id: Pengurangan denda bisa dibatalkan dan jumlah kembali
steps.why_en: Reduction revival exists only as TS-RED; amount restore can be skipped or fail silently.
steps.why_id: Revival reduction hanya lewat TS-RED; pengembalian jumlah bisa terlewat atau gagal diam-diam.
